title: Relief Rally: Nasdaq Soars 7% as Buyers Storm Back
lede: After the worst week of the month, buyers returned in force on Monday. The Nasdaq 100 jumped 7%, the S&P 500 gained 4.71% and Jakarta rose 1.35% — a sharp reversal that still left sentiment gauges stuck at extreme fear.

paras: The IHSG rose 1.35% to 5,215.85, its first gain of the week. Bank Indonesia raised its benchmark rate by 25 basis points to 6.00%, framing the move as strengthening stability while supporting growth.
The rebound in New York was emphatic: the Nasdaq 100 soared 7.00%, the S&P 500 climbed 4.71% and the Dow added 3.06%. Gold joined in, up 3.14% — the mirror image of Friday's rout.
Crypto sat out the party. Bitcoin finished flat at $61,271 and Ether slipped 0.79% to $1,711, lagging equities badly on the year's biggest relief day.
